messages:
kevin: Quick RFC follow-up on the offline packaging: proposing a minimal 'seed + delta chain' rollforward for air-gapped installs. Goal: reduce operator bandwidth/time and make resumable applies easy.

kevin: Key pieces: 1) tiny signed seed image (index + minimal blobs), 2) chunked deltas referencing seed blobs, 3) signed manifest with hash-chain + activation window, 4) verifier agent that streams apply and exposes resume checkpoints.

kevin: Example manifest sketch:
```
seed: {id: "seed-v1", size: 12MB, sig: "..."}
deltas: [ {id: "d1", parent: "seed-v1", chunks: [...], hash: "..."}, ... ]
apply_window: {start: 0, timeout_secs: 3600}
rollback_anchor: "seed-v1"
```

rida: short Q: how do we ensure atomic activation on low-disk nodes? if apply fails mid-way we risk partial activation.

samir: verifier should write explicit checkpoint files and treat activation as a final two-phase step: stream blobs -> verify -> prepare -> swap -> activate. Activation only flips symlink/marker. Keep previous root until success.

elaine: Operator UX: need simple commands: `ri-agent resume --manifest x`, `ri-agent dry-run --manifest x`, and clear progress logs. Also want a metric for "remaining bytes" so console can show ETA.

kevin: agree. proposal: add an "apply_plan" block to manifest that lists per-blob sizes + expected peak-disk. Agent refuses apply if estimated_peak > free_space * threshold.

samir: also add a "preflight": true option that runs checksum/dry-verify without writing to final paths so operators can sanity-check before starting.

rida: thoughts on rollback semantics? do we keep a compact undo-delta or just fall back to the previous seed image? Undo deltas can be expensive in airgap.

kevin: prefer "fallback to previous seed" model. Keep last N seeds (configurable). That keeps sandbox simple. We should support an optional compact undo-delta for tiny fixes only.

elaine: for upgrades across major layout changes, we should include an "apply_migration" hook that runs migration scripts in a chroot, with a timeout and explicit operator confirmation for risky steps.

samir: one more: include per-chunk backoff/retry metadata so the transfer layer can resume partial chunk streams without restarting the whole blob.

kevin: good call. also we should include signer metadata so the verifier can fetch signer cert bundles from a pre-provisioned store. No external CA calls during apply.

deploy-bot: CI: packaging test for `seed+delta` created; artifact sizes: seed=11.9MB, deltas avg=2.3MB, end-to-end apply test (simulated low-disk) passed with resume.

rida: add to RFC follow-up: 1) finalize manifest schema, 2) implement `apply_plan` size estimator, 3) UX commands + metrics, 4) test matrix for low-disk/resume/rollback. I'll make a PR for the schema.

kevin: awesome. I'll update the RFC doc with the two-phase activation flow and the seed retention policy. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
